title: Rock Quality Designation (RQD)
equation: RQD = (Σ length of intact core pieces ≥ 10 cm) / (total core run length) × 100%
applicability: NX-size or larger core. Only hard, sound pieces ≥ 10 cm counted. Fresh mechanical breaks counted as intact.

title: RQD from Volumetric Joint Count
applicability: For J_v > 4.5. If J_v ≤ 4.5, use RQD = 100%.

I_s(50).description: Point load index corrected to 50 mm equivalent diameter

title: UCS from Point Load Index
applicability: K must be calibrated for specific rock types. Common default K = 22–24. Use with caution for anisotropic rocks.

title: RQD from Mean Discontinuity Frequency

λ.description: Mean discontinuity frequency (joints per meter along scanline)

applicability: Assumes negative exponential distribution of joint spacings. Threshold length t = 0.1 m.
